specs.Item Highlight: 50MP Camera & 1080P Video | 8X Digital Zoom | Anti-Shake & Beauty Mode | Compact & Lightweight | USB & Phone Connectivity

features: 50MP High-Resolution Camera: Capture detailed photos and crisp 1080P videos with clear imaging for everyday photography, travel and memories.
1080P Video Recording: Record smooth, clear videos with Full HD 1080P resolution, suitable for beginners, students and casual content creation.
8X Digital Zoom: Bring distant subjects closer with 8X digital zoom and a telescopic lens for convenient framing and photography.
Anti-Shake & Beauty Mode: Electronic image stabilization helps reduce camera movement, while beauty mode adds creative options for portraits and selfies.
Timed Selfie Capture: Choose 2s, 5s or 10s timed capture modes to take selfies, group photos and creative shots with greater convenience.
Compact Travel Camera: Lightweight at approximately 250g with a 2.4-inch screen, making it convenient to carry for travel, school and outdoor photography.
USB & Phone Connectivity: Transfer captured photos and videos through USB and connect with a phone for convenient storage, viewing and sharing.
